response.sql: WITH project_spatial AS (SELECT p.fundflux, s.aream2, s.volm3, s.boxx, s.boxy FROM projects p INNER JOIN scanspatial s ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref), funding_metrics AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG((boxy - boxx) / NULLIF(boxx, 0)) as avg_y_vs_x_diff, SUM(aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(volm3), 0) as area_to_volume_ratio FROM project_spatial GROUP BY fundflux), cross_avg AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) as global_avg FROM funding_metrics WHERE area_to_volume_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT fm.fundflux, fm.avg_y_vs_x_diff, fm.area_to_volume_ratio, fm.area_to_volume_ratio - ca.global_avg as above_average FROM funding_metrics fm CROSS JOIN cross_avg ca WHERE fm.area_to_volume_ratio > ca.global_avg ORDER BY fm.fundflux;
